description: Election Commission - Declare that R. M. H. M. Udayajeewa as a member of the Soranathota Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Soranathota Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating and declaring a new elected member, which falls directly under electoral processes and related administrative matters for local authorities.
